# MathOs

> A completely free online summer applied math camp for students roughly at the 4th–7th grade math level. Live on Zoom, Tuesdays and Thursdays, 3–5 PM Central, July 7–30, 2026.

MathOs is a free, fully online summer math camp run by student Camp Directors. Sessions are taught live over Zoom with a focus on hands-on, applied math — problem solving, games, geometry, and project work — culminating in a final showcase.
